texts: The mixed form of TAPVC occurs in about 10 percent: D.

The supracardiac form, draining to the innominate vein or SVC through a vertical vein, is the most common, close to half of cases; cardiac (to the coronary sinus or right atrium) and infracardiac (below the diaphragm) forms make up most of the rest.
An interatrial communication is essential: it is the only route by which blood reaches the left heart.
In the picture, of the four tap forms, the mixed one with taps at two levels is the rarest, 10 percent.
Memory hook: taps at two levels: one in ten.
